english_translation: This meat became very tough when it was cooked.
grammar_notes: Concordial Agreement (Zvivakashure): Notice how 'Nyama' establishes the noun class/subject frame (Mupanda 9 (i-/dzi-) Mass Noun).
Agglutinative Morphology: 'kwayo' combines prefixal/suffixal morphemes (Ø- (Cl. 5/9) + -kwayo (root)) with tone contour H-L.
Penultimate Lengthening: In Zezuru declarative sentences, the second-to-last syllable of the phrase carries natural vowel lengthening.
cultural_notes: In Harare Zezuru standard speech, speakers maintain strict alliterative concord (zvivakashure) across noun classes while using respectful plural forms (hunhu).
